caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular wooden panel painted with the image of a standing human figure draped in a red garment with yellow and green accents, holding a plant or staff with a cluster of flowers at the top in their left hand. The figure has light skin and a yellow halo around the head, with short, dark hair and beard. The right arm is bent at the elbow, holding a small child who is also light-skinned and partially draped in a light-colored garment; the child has short hair and is positioned near the adult figure's shoulder. The background is composed of a pinkish-red color with dark gray and black outlining drapery or fabric at the top, and a green, textured section with swirling dark lines at the bottom. The surface of the wooden panel is visible, with natural grain, vertical cracks, and some irregularities at the top edge.
title: Santo (St. Joseph)
